subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: When an explicitly configured `gateway.bind: "tailnet"` cannot bind its Tailscale address, must gateway startup fail, or may it continue on loopback in a prominently reported degraded state?
rationale: Fail-closed behavior preserves the explicit reachability boundary, while loopback degradation preserves local availability during transient Tailscale failures; current source and documentation do not settle that tradeoff.

options.title: Fail explicit tailnet startup
options.body: Reject startup with a non-zero exit and actionable Tailscale diagnostics whenever the selected Tailnet address is missing or unbindable.

options.title: Visible loopback degradation
options.body: Continue on loopback only with an explicit degraded runtime state, high-visibility logs and status, and no Tailnet advertisement or success messaging.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit tailnet startup
recommendation.body: Reject startup with a non-zero exit and actionable Tailscale diagnostics whenever the selected Tailnet address is missing or unbindable.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing evidence connects this account to current gateway remote-access and security-policy documentation and this issue's discussion.
